about.label: About Our Clinic
about.title: Care That Begins With Understanding
paragraphs: Mishra Homopathy Clinic provides consultations for patients seeking guidance for their individual health concerns.
Our approach focuses on listening to patients, understanding their concerns and relevant medical history, and communicating clearly throughout the consultation process.

mission.description: To provide respectful, patient-focused consultations where individuals feel heard, informed and supported.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To build lasting patient relationships through clear communication, responsible practice and a welcoming clinic environment.

values.title: Clear Communication
values.description: Explain the consultation process and help patients make informed decisions.

values.title: Responsible Care
